profile.role_note: Electro hypercarry; most of his Intuition-state damage counts as Resonance Liberation DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip his reruns — his kit has been powercrept by newer DPS like Augusta. If you already own him (he was free in version 1.2), he's still a serviceable Electro hypercarry worth building.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Verity's Handle + 5-piece Void Thunder in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Thundering Mephis in the main slot. Aim for Crit Rate or Crit DMG on the 4-cost, double Electro DMG on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs, and stack Crit, Energy Regen, and Resonance Liberation DMG in substats.

ranked_weapons.name: Verity's Handle
ranked_weapons.note: His signature: 12% Attribute DMG plus 48% Resonance Liberation DMG after Liberation, extendable by Resonance Skill casts; Crit Rate substat. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
ranked_weapons.note: Newer 5-star; ATK% plus Resonance Liberation DMG on Intro/Liberation and DEF-ignore stacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner 5-star stat stick; Energy Regen plus Basic Attack and Resonance Skill DMG bonuses. Outclassed by newer 5-stars.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star option; Resonance Skill cast grants 18% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.

build.weapon_filler_note: S5 Gauntlets of Night works as a free placeholder, and Marcato speeds up Concerto Energy generation; neither matches a 5-star.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Still his BiS even in 3.7 per Game8: stacks Electro DMG on Heavy Attack/Resonance Skill; Nightmare: Thundering Mephis adds Electro and Liberation DMG without needing its echo skill.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Early-game placeholder while farming a full 5-pc Void Thunder set.

stat_priorities.note: Pick whichever keeps your Crit Rate:DMG ratio near 1:2; target 60%+ Crit Rate and 150%+ Crit DMG.
Double Electro DMG is optimal; ATK% is a weaker substitute.
ATK% on both; his kit scales with ATK.

build.energy_regen_target: No dedicated target in current guides; Energy Regen sits third in substat priority for rotation comfort.

teams.name: Premium: Xiangli Yao + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Hypercarry whose Intuition-state attacks count as Resonance Liberation DMG.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Liberation and Outro hand out All DMG and Resonance Liberation DMG buffs; also boosts Tune Break DMG.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Syntony Field sustain with interruption resistance, faster Off-Tune Buildup, enemy DMG-taken increase, and teamwide All DMG amp.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens to set up her Syntony Field sustain and Tune Break support; Lynae builds Liberation, then Outro into Xiangli Yao. Xiangli Yao takes an extended on-field window — Resonance Skill, basic-attack stack building, Resonance Liberation, then his enhanced Resonance Skill combo — while Lynae's and Mornye's buffs are active.

teams.name: Alternative: Xiangli Yao + Yinlin + Shorekeeper

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Classic Electro hypercarry; benefits enormously from Yinlin's coordinated-attack support kit.

members.name: Yinlin
members.note: Coordinated attacks; Outro grants 20% Electro DMG and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG — tailor-made for his kit.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Universal Crit and damage buffs plus healing; fits literally any DPS.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and builds energy; Yinlin runs her full combo and Outro into Xiangli Yao with her Electro and Resonance Liberation buffs; Xiangli Yao runs his full Intuition combo — Resonance Skill, basics, Liberation, enhanced skill — before the rotation loops.

teams.name: Budget: Xiangli Yao + Sanhua + Verina

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Hypercarry; most damage comes from his Liberation-scaling Intuition state.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free 4-star quick-swap sub-DPS; Outro grants 38% Basic Attack DMG for his stack-building phase.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer; Outro deepens the whole team's DMG.

teams.rotation: Verina buffs and heals before swapping out; Sanhua quick-swaps to apply her Outro's Basic Attack DMG buff; Xiangli Yao then takes his full on-field burst window as the hypercarry.

tier_badge.label: Solid but powercrept
tier_badge.note: Beebom's Oct 2026 v3.7 list and Game8's endgame ranks place him at A; MMO Culture (3.6) and Pocket Gamer rank him B. Outclassed by newer DPS like Augusta.
